description: Reads an AI answer open in a Chrome tab (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Mode or AI Overviews) in the user's own session. Use it after the user has asked a buyer question there; it never types or sends a prompt. Returns the engine, the prompt as shown, the brands named in order with the passage naming each, the cited URLs, and for the brand and each competitor a verdict: cited (a citation points at its domains), named, or absent. Needs the Chrome extension and an open answer tab; an error says when the tab holds no answer it can read.

brand.description: The brand to look for in the answer, such as "Acme Running".

competitors.description: Competitor brand names to look for as well. Defaults to none.

domains.description: The brand's own domains without a scheme, such as ["acme.example"], so citations of them count as the brand being cited. Defaults to none, which leaves every citation unattributed to the brand.

tabUrl.description: The URL of the open tab holding the answer. Defaults to the active tab. Works on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews.

name: read_ai_answer
title: Read an AI answer
